sealed.statement: The existing C4 measuring validator and exact C10 projection binding extend to heterogeneous paired receipts, repeated resource windows, and scale-rooted profile identity so the same immutable evidence bytes produce canonical validity outcomes and outcome-neutral measured_p0 or no_claim projections.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Extend C4's existing measuring validator, content-addressed matrix/effect envelope, and generic root assembler plus C10's existing claim projector; do not add a parallel evidence schema, admission owner, effect calculator, root assembler, or projection path.

C4 remains the owner of exact multi-cell matrix assembly and repeated resource-window joins. Its bounded root must accept heterogeneous C3 receipts and bind exactly one distinct resource window, identity, and time range to every measured-run coordinate (matrixCellId, blockIndex, blockedOrderIndex, sideId, offeredLoad/loadIndex, phase=measured). The two side windows share a paired-block identity but never a window identity; warmup windows remain separately identified. Reject missing, duplicate, overlapping, cross-side, cross-load, phase-mismatched, or count-mismatched joins, and expose effects without a workload-local schema.

Measuring admission must be derived from resolved C3-owned capacity/operation receipts, semantic-parity receipts, both sides' owner-derived live observables, quantitative unsaturated load-generation evidence, complete C4 resource windows, exact source/profile identities, and valid digests; a caller-supplied boolean, profile label, validation flag, result, or claim label must never admit a cell.

Use one shared typed outcome union across C4, campaign consumers, and C10: MEASURING; valid NON_MEASURING with an enumerated reason; INVALID for malformed or tampered bytes; STALE_INELIGIBLE for freshness/profile failure; and TRANSIENT for retryable missing observation. Tampering or invalidity must never be normalized into non-measurement, and every reason retains one exact shape and retry classification.

Root the scale owner's exact P0 envelope/profile digest in the C4 matrix evidence. C10 must match its expected profile to that rooted identity and must not trust or infer eligibility from caller-supplied item.profile or evidence-class labels.

C4 enforcement and C10 projection must consume the same resolved immutable bytes, root digest, effect digests, and profile digest. Snapshot or re-hash resolved bytes before either decision; mutable-resolver or time-of-check/time-of-use drift is INVALID rather than two inconsistent verdicts.
Capacity and infrastructure-cost eligibility remain independent: missing or invalid regional price evidence suppresses cost only, while a valid P0 capacity effect may still project measured_p0.

Validity depends on evidence completeness and comparability, never on Lagrange winning. A valid measured effect may still project no_claim when its interval is practically inconclusive; losses, neutral results, and wins use the same path.

claim: Current-code projection accepts generic live P0 fixture evidence while durable workload roots expose zero measuring cells and no evidence-rooted profile identity; the C4-to-C10 binding gap reproduces on the supervised attempt base.

On the supervised attempt base, C4 lacked exact repeated C3 coordinate joins and a scale-rooted profile; the new admission scenario reproduces the gap before the patch and now passes with the owner binding in place.
